title: A fixed line total whose parts all cost $0 splits by quantity
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new category for this test, category B, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix B, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, with line 1 with a fixed line total of $340.00 ($240.00 labor) holding a part in category A, quantity 3, and a part in category B, quantity 1, both with cost $0.00, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Category.
  2. Pick customer B in the Customer filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Category opens.

Step 2:

  • Category A reads $75.00 ($100.00 × 3 ÷ 4) and category B $25.00 ($100.00 × 1 ÷ 4).
  • $75.00 + $25.00 = $100.00, the parts amount ($340.00 − $240.00).
